name: archi
description: Source-backed architecture diagrams for VS Code workspaces
author: Tinotendamupezeni

viewsWelcome.contents:
### Archi Architecture Studio
Understand, design, and simulate system architectures directly from source code and PRD documents.

[$(search) Analyze Workspace](command:archi.analyzeWorkspace)
Extract live architecture maps from Docker Compose, Django/SQLAlchemy models, routes, and tasks.

[$(sparkle) Design Architecture from PRD](command:archi.designFromPrd)
Turn a PRD or spec into an interactive diagram with live security and health critiques.

[$(history) Open Last Diagram](command:archi.openLastDiagram)
Restore your last explored architecture canvas.

[$(file-code) Select Compose File](command:archi.selectComposeFile)
Choose a specific Docker Compose manifest.

archi.maxFiles.description: Maximum workspace files considered during analysis.

archi.serviceAliases.description: Map Compose service names to a shared logical service name.

archi.serviceGroups.description: Map logical service names to area labels in the architecture map.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/graph.test.js dist/test/compose.test.js dist/test/pythonModels.test.js dist/test/pythonRoutes.test.js dist/test/pythonTasks.test.js dist/test/viewState.test.js dist/test/prdArchitecture.test.js dist/test/graphSandbox.test.js dist/test/deepCritique.test.js dist/test/scaffoldGenerator.test.js dist/test/driftEngine.test.js test/webview.test.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --githubBranch main
